# JUDO JSL TextMate Bundle

> TextMate grammar-based syntax highlighting for the JUDO Specific Language (JSL), packaged as a Maven JAR artifact for editor integrations and JUDO tooling.

Key facts:
- Language: XML plist (TextMate grammar format), built with Java 11 / Maven 3.9.4+
- Single-module Maven project — no Java source code, the deliverable is one grammar file
- Provides syntax highlighting for JSL: the DSL used across the JUDO platform for data models, transfer objects, UI views, and actor-based access control
- Compatible with VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, Sublime Text, and all TextMate-aware editors
- Published to both JUDO Nexus and Maven Central
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, grammar architecture, build instructions, and installation guide
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer documentation with directory structure, build commands, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): How to submit issues and pull requests
- [doc/install-idea.md](doc/install-idea.md): Step-by-step JetBrains IDE installation guide

## Core Files

- [Syntaxes/jsl.tmLanguage](Syntaxes/jsl.tmLanguage): Core grammar definition — regex-based syntax rules for all JSL constructs (entity, transfer, view, row, actor, enum blocks)
- [info.plist](info.plist): TextMate bundle metadata (name: "JSL", UUID)
- [pom.xml](pom.xml): Maven build configuration with CI-friendly `${revision}` versioning and deployment profiles
